difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises total acyclicity of an abelian sheaf on a site by two conditions: the vanishing of its cohomology on all objects, and the exactness of the extended Cech complexes associated to every surjection of sheaves of sets (statement lines 2144-2158). The proof is an induction on the degree of exactness: the vanishing in hypothesis (1) provides the initial case (proof lines 2160-2176), and the induction hypothesis IH_n is stepped up using the long exact sequences obtained from a surjection of sheaves of sets (proof lines 2179-2196). The non-formal content is the induction over the extended Cech complex. The claim is H2: one induction with a clearly stated hypothesis.
